item_short_desc: The Shorty Ka-Bar USMC Fighting Knife is a compact version of the legendary Ka-Bar knife, featuring a 5 1/4-inch blade and measuring 9 1/4 inches overall. This knife retains the classic design and durability that Ka-Bar is known for, making it an essential tool for various cutting tasks. The blade is crafted from high-quality stainless steel, ensuring long-lasting sharpness and reliability. The handle is made from durable leather, providing a comfortable and secure grip.
